summary: Implemented GeneralizedWassersteinDiceLoss in monai/losses/dice.py (after GeneralizedDiceLoss, with the four helper methods and the generalized_wasserstein_dice alias), added numpy and torch.nn.functional imports, exported the class from monai/losses/__init__.py, and added tests/test_generalized_wasserstein_dice_loss.py with the binary 2D and empty-class cases.
